evaluate_class_docstring_completeness: use ClassCompletenessEvaluator to evaluate the completeness of a Python class docstring and get a score
evaluate_function_docstring_completeness: use FunctionCompletenessEvaluator to evaluate the completeness of a Python function docstring and get a score
evaluate_class_summary: use ClassCompletenessEvaluator.evaluate_summary to check if a docstring has a proper one-liner summary
evaluate_function_args: use FunctionCompletenessEvaluator.evaluate_args to check if a docstring documents its function arguments
evaluate_class_attributes: use ClassCompletenessEvaluator.evaluate_attributes to check if a docstring documents class attributes
